title: CutRight post-publish retention sample
description: One line of an optional `<project>/feedback/retention.jsonl` ledger (REV2 plan §15.7 Phase 9). This input does not exist yet anywhere in the pipeline — no stage currently writes it. It is defined so that when a publish/analytics integration lands, retention can be joined back to the exact final-render artifact it was measured on (by output_blake3, matched against a decision record's subject_blake3) instead of being estimated or invented. Until a producer exists, `videoctl preferences recommend` simply reports zero retention samples.

output_path.description: Project-relative path to the exact rendered final artifact this sample measures, e.g. render/finals/youtube.mp4.

output_blake3.description: Hash of the exact bytes published, in the same blake3:<hex> form the decision ledger's subject_blake3 uses, so a sample can only be joined to the decision that reviewed those exact bytes.

preset.description: Output preset id the sample was published under (youtube|reels|tiktok|...), when known.

metric.description: Name of the retention metric, e.g. avg_view_duration_ms, retention_ratio_30s. Not enumerated here: the analytics source defines its own metric vocabulary.
